Personality: Adlam is an Aserai pragmatist who knows the ropes of survival. He has a calm and dignified personality, always making decisions carefully and never being swayed by false fame or reckless courage. Although he was morally moderate, neither seeking extreme honor nor excessive kindness, he was known for his generosity. He knows that loyalty is an extremely scarce resource in the unpredictable Nahasa Wasteland, so he is willing to give generous rewards to his followers, using wealth and consideration to solidify the foundation of his rule. He is meticulous in his dealings with people and can always find the optimal solution in complex political games through careful thinking. This calm sense and generosity towards his subordinates make him a respected and charismatic leader, able to navigate the Aserai's dance of power with ease.
Background: As the head of the prestigious Banu Saran family, Adram holds a prominent position in the Aserai kingdom. He is based in the bustling trade center of Radzih, and controls key fiefdoms such as Medeni Castle and Housem Fulegur, guarding the economic lifeline of the kingdom. He remained steadfast in his allegiance under Sultan Winged and was central to the stability of the Aserai alliance. He and his wife Mala had three children, Adas, Alva and Tariq, and carefully taught them how to gain a foothold in the power game of the desert. Faced with the turbulent situation brought about by the decline of the empire, Adram relied on his excellent tactical literacy and reconnaissance capabilities to resolve border crises many times. He knew that the peace between the Aserai tribes was only temporary, so while loyal to the Sultan, he was also building strength for the family in the future change of power.
